before: A new link in a document without a hyperlink character style named no style, so it looked like the text around it. Insert link and Add comment needed a selected range. Undo after a table of contents command from its menu put the caret back where it was before the menu opened.
after: The first new link adds the built-in Hyperlink character style to the styles part in the same transaction as the link, and the run names it. A caret inside a word makes that word the link or comment range. A table of contents command from its menu moves the caret to the table of contents first, so undo returns there.
reason: The style is an ordinary styles-part edit inside the link's own commit, and replicas already exchange styles-part changes. Two participants that each add the first link while apart converge on one style. No shared field, mark, identity, or format version changes. sharedSchemaVersion and repairVersion do not change.
